excerpt: 10 Reasons Why Immigrants Still Choose Canada Over Other Countries Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Canada remains one of the top destinations for immigrants worldwide, even as it adjusts its immigration targets for the coming years. Whether you’re a skilled worker, student, entrepreneur, or looking to reunite with family, Canada offers unique benefits, opportunities, and welcoming pathways that attract people from every corner of the globe. Here are the ten key reasons why immigrants choose Canada and continue to prefer it for permanent residency and a new life.
author: Anuj Sengar
